svg.title: 02_input_board.svg
svg.desc: Labelled rectangular devices, terminal names at every conductor end, and continuous wire paths. Design draft.

g.text: Every X00–X31 channel is shown with its incoming conductor.
DESIGN DRAFT • TBD = terminal/pin or wire specification not yet verified • Repeated device labels refer to the same device.
Wire colors indicate function. Actual harness colors and AWG remain TBD unless explicitly printed.
Verify the COM bank polarity and numbering against the exact board before connecting.
Factory +12V sources use a protected sinking interface. X labels are input channel numbers, not factory connector pin numbers.

Isolated adapter bus-reference/shield connection follows its specific manual; do not bridge isolation by guessing a ground connection.
Factory signal • never direct to Pi
The repurposed defrost/start button uses X08. X09 is a separate contact/input only if physically present; software intent handling does not create a second wire.
X30/X31 are unassigned: shown in the map, leave unwired. Verify ground-switch behavior on every factory switch. Preserve independent brake-light operation.
Source: repository design docs, fuse schedule and hardware inventory. Pin order is not a physical PCB layout.
